blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–In a full-circle moment, Alex Eala met her childhood hero, Maria Sharapova, as a guest on the tennis legend’s podcast, Pretty Tough. The episode featuring the Filipino sensation premieres on Thursday (Manila time). Sharapova posted a video teaser on her Instagram. READ: Alex Eala admits she ‘gets overwhelmed sometimes’ by expectations “By very popular demand and rightfully so…she’s the girl of the moment @alex.eala ✨💫 Tomorrow on @PrettyTough I cannot wait for you to listen to this one!!” In the short clip, Eala even showed Sharapova a picture of her with the five-time Grand Slam winner and former World No. […]...
